flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/BatchUpdateODH (generic Batch Update of Mailing Address screen: form/RegisteredAddressDetails, list/BatchUpdateODHList, form/MailingAddressForm), ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/stafffurnish/{controllers/StaffFurnishController.searchByIdNo, services/StaffFurnishService.searchOutstandingNoticesByIdNo}. No OIC work item or court application batch code.
note: URA status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault permission for the api App Service server; cannot verify from repo). After the error-notice work item reaches the OIC dashboard, the story asks OCMS to pre-populate and show the latest known address and its creation date. The work item does not exist (see OCMS22.11), so no screen opens from a work item. What exists is the generic staff screen 'Batch Update of Mailing Address', searched by offender ID: it shows the registered address (mha_reg/lta_reg) and the mailing address (furnished_mail) for outstanding notices. That is a generic mechanism, not this story's screen, so Sebagian at best. The address creation date is not shown (no creDate in the response item or list columns). The 'latest' address is picked with findFirst without sorting by date (StaffFurnishService.java:813-816). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim in full. Only the generic Batch Update of Mailing Address screen shows the registered and mailing address; there is no OIC work item and no address creation date. Ask URA/team whether this generic screen is accepted for the story

steps.step: The OIC opens the error-notice work item from the dashboard and sees the problem notices
steps.detail: There is no work item (OCMS22.11) and the OIC dashboard is empty (Dashboard.tsx:22-30). The closest screen is the batch-update-odh route (App.tsx:242-243), opened manually by staff through an ID search, not from a work item.

steps.step: The latest known address is pre-populated and displayed for the notice
steps.detail: The generic Batch Update of Mailing Address screen calls POST staff-furnish/search-by-id, which returns the registered address (mha_reg or lta_reg, from MHA/DataHive) and the mailing address (furnished_mail) per outstanding notice (StaffFurnishService.java:813-825; controller StaffFurnishController.java:330-382), and the UI shows them (RegisteredAddressDetails.tsx:17-30). This is not the story's work item screen, and 'latest' is just findFirst without sorting by date (:813-816). The endpoint is listed in api-authorization.properties:90. MHA/DataHive results in the environment: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The creation date of the address is displayed with the address
steps.detail: The NoticeDetailItem returned by search-by-id only holds name, ID, registered address, notice details (including noticeDateAndTime, the notice date), mailing address and contact (FurnishResponse.java:253-285); there is no address creation date (creDate/effective date). The UI list uses the resource staff-furnish/search-by-id (BatchUpdateODHList.tsx:78) with notice columns, not an address date.

steps.step: From that view the OIC can choose to amend the address or reject the notice from the court application batch
steps.detail: The generic screen only offers the mailing address edit form (MailingAddressForm.tsx:65-133: postal code, block, street, floor, building, setAsLetterAddress). There is no action to reject a notice from the court application batch in any screen or API.
